response: Vitamin D insufficiency or deficiency is related to the development of osteochondritis dissecans (OCD). According to the available data, a vitamin D3 deficiency, rather than an insufficiency, may be involved in the development of OCD lesions. It is suggested that vitamin D3 substitution could potentially prevent the development of advanced OCD stages. However, further analyses are needed to confirm this relationship and to understand the underlying mechanisms, including the possible role of osteomalacia and other determinants of bone metabolism.
